title: North Sea Energy Transition Window Narrowed
summary: The North Sea Transition Taskforce reports that the window for a successful energy transition in the UK Continental Shelf has narrowed.

title: Chip Turf War Brews in China
summary: China's semiconductor industry faces increasing competition as CXMT enters the NAND market and YMTC expands into new areas.

title: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900 AI Processor
summary: Alibaba's chip unit T-Head previewed its most powerful AI processor for training and inference, with production slated for Q1 2027.

title: 2025 DRAM Module Market Grew 59%
summary: TrendForce reports that the global DRAM module market grew 59 percent year-over-year in 2025 to reach $21.2 billion.

title: Three Firms Unite Into Medical Device Organization
summary: MRPC, PDC, and Injectech are combining precision molding, silicone, and fluid management capabilities under a unified brand in early 2027.

title: Google Finances Nuclear Uprates in Georgia
summary: Georgia Power and Google agreed to uprate nuclear units at Plants Vogtle and Hatch to add 96 MW of capacity, pending approval.

title: GLP-1 Drugs Boost ResMed Sleep Apnea Therapy Adherence
summary: ResMed data shows that GLP-1 weight loss drugs are unexpectedly driving higher CPAP therapy adherence rates.

title: DOE Allocates $99M for Geothermal Projects
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy announced over $99 million for 21 geothermal energy projects across the United States to advance technology and exploration.

title: Wafer-Scale Sub-5nm MoS2 Transistors Developed
summary: Researchers reported monolayer MoS2 transistors with physical channel lengths below 5 nm, achieving subthreshold performance beyond the silicon limit.

title: Thermal Visual Place Recognition via Analytic Online Adaptation
summary: A novel framework integrates analytic class-incremental learning with domain-invariant visual place recognition to achieve robust real-time SLAM localization.

title: Single-Sensor Underwater Navigation in Unsteady Flows
summary: Researchers demonstrated a causal observer using finite flow histories from a single sensing unit to aid underwater navigation in wake simulations.

title: Bilevel Optimization for Multi-Agent Incentive Design
summary: A new framework and algorithm use side payments to align independent agent behaviors with a leader's objective in multi-agent systems.

title: Designing Multi-kW Power Delivery in 3D Integrated Systems
summary: University of Minnesota researchers published a technical paper addressing multi-kW power delivery methodologies for advanced 3D heterogeneous integration.

title: GPUThor Attack Amplifies Rowhammer on Protected GPUs
summary: University of Toronto researchers developed GPUThor, a high-intensity Rowhammer attack that exploits non-uniform hammering patterns on ECC-protected NVIDIA GPUs.

title: Canadian Startup Achieves Space Qualification Success
summary: Novigrad has advanced faster and more accessible radiation testing to meet the growing demand for reliable electronics in space missions.

title: Deep Learning Segmentation of Laryngeal Structures
summary: U-Net models trained on high-speed videoendoscopy data achieved high accuracy in segmenting laryngeal tissues during connected speech and vowel phonation.

title: Post-Hoc Conformal Prediction for Wireless Communications
summary: A new statistical framework provides distribution-free reliability guarantees and estimates miscoverage probabilities for data-driven wireless applications.

title: Reduced Order Observers for Monocular Visual Inertial Odometry
summary: A novel reduced order observer framework uses gravity and monocular bearing measurements to estimate body-frame velocity without landmark position estimation.

title: MoE Framework with Diffusion Models Secures 6G Networks
summary: A mixture-of-experts framework using generative diffusion models provides robust cross-scenario physical layer security for future 6G networks.

title: Decentralized MPC Enables Docking with Tumbling Targets
summary: Multiple small servicers use a decentralized model predictive control framework to rendezvous and dock safely with a tumbling target.

title: Deep Koopman MPC Automates Wheel Loader V-Cycles
summary: A hierarchical framework combining geometric planning and deep Koopman models enables real-time autonomous wheel-loader V-cycle maneuvers.

title: Learning-Based Control for Air-Ground Bimodal Vehicles
summary: A new framework integrates a learned mode selector and a reinforcement learning policy for robust air-ground motion control and cross-terrain tracking.

title: Positive Real Synthesis for Sixth-Order Interval Polynomials
summary: Researchers provided a constructive proof that every Hurwitz-stable sixth-order interval polynomial family admits a real numerator for strict positive realness.

title: Finite-Horizon Robustness Analysis via Signal-IQCs
summary: A new worst-case analysis framework combines bounded signals and partially known disturbances using signal integral-quadratic constraints for finite-horizon systems.

title: LPV Controller Streamlines Spacecraft Mode Transitions
summary: A single linear parameter-varying controller improves transient behavior and simplifies verification for spacecraft mode transitions.

title: Plug-and-Play Stability Certificates Using Black-Box Models
summary: Decentralized plug-and-play stability certificates are derived using black-box admittance spectra without requiring white-box device models.

title: Pioneering Bioinspired Robotics and Sustainability
summary: Roboticist Barbara Mazzolai advocates for a new field of sustainability robotics to reduce technology's environmental footprint.

title: UK Construction Sector Lacks Understanding of Chalk Foundations
summary: Attendees at the John Mitchell lecture heard that the UK built environment sector still has lessons to learn about chalk foundations.

title: ICE Launches New Careers App for Students
summary: The ICE has launched a mobile app to help civil engineering and infrastructure students navigate their career journeys.

title: Scientists Watch Sound Jump Between Quantum States
summary: Stanford researchers recorded the first real-time quantum jumps of sound, watching single phonons abruptly vanish between energy states.
